title:
Invitation to Speak at the 4th  Annual Women in AML & Sanctions Forum
  October 6-7, 2026   Washington, DC
description:
Esther,

I received your name from Kayce Siefert. I would like to invite you to speak at the 4th Annual Women in AML and Sanctions Forum taking place on October 6-7, 2026, in Washington, DC.

Attaching my preliminary 2026 agenda. Please take a look and let me know 2-3 sessions that you would be comfortable joining.  Most sessions are panels with 2-3 people.
As a speaker, you will receive a complimentary registration to the conference.

Thank you for your consideration.  Happy to provide more details virtually if you have time for a quick call.

Best,
Rachel

Rachel Lewyn
Director, Economic Sanctions
American Conference Institute
